description: This is a Java test class for verifying the paging functionality in search persistence of a service that manages 'things'. It includes setup for test data, multiple test cases verifying pagination behavior, limits, and handling of deleted items.

classes.name: PagingIT
classes.description: Test class for verifying pagination in search persistence.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test configuration, loads limits configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment before each test.

methods.name: pageWithItemsCountLessThanLimit
methods.description: Tests page with fewer items than the limit.

methods.name: pageWithItemsCountEqualToLimit
methods.description: Tests page with exactly limit number of items.

methods.name: pageWithSkipAndLimitLessThanTotalItems
methods.description: Tests pagination with skip and limit less than total items.

methods.name: lastPageWithItemsCountLessThanLimit
methods.description: Tests last page with fewer items than the limit.

methods.name: lastPageWithItemsCountEqualToLimit
methods.description: Tests last page with items exactly equal to the limit.

methods.name: defaultLimitValue
methods.description: Verifies default limit is applied when no specific limit is set.

methods.name: limitValueExceedsMaximum
methods.description: Checks that exceeding maximum limit throws an exception.

methods.name: pageSkipsDeletedItems
methods.description: Ensures pagination skips over deleted items.

methods.name: assertPaging
methods.description: Helper method to assert expected paging results.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Inserts a collection of Thing IDs into the persistence layer for testing.

methods.name: shuffleAndPersist
methods.description: Randomizes the order of things and persists them.

methods.name: executeVersionedQueryWithChangeOptions
methods.description: Constructs and runs a query with specified change options.

calls: methods to insert, delete, create Things
